style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Frosted Christmas Berry & Cone Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Transform your home into a winter wonderland with this 180cm artificial frosted berry & cone garland. Designed to capture the essence of a snowy woodland, it features a lush mix of frosted berries, pine cones, and lifelike greenery for a beautifully festive look. The garland is crafted with attention to detail, with textured accents and naturalistic foliage that bring depth and charm to your décor. Its frosted finish adds a crisp, seasonal touch, making it ideal for draping along mantels, staircases, doorways, or tablescapes. Measuring a generous 180cm in length, it offers versatile styling options to suit any festive display. This garland provides lasting beauty, allowing you to enjoy its wintry elegance year after year. Perfect for adding warmth, texture, and a touch of seasonal magic, this frosted berry & cone garland is a stunning way to enhance your Christmas décor. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Garland Length: 180cm.
